reason: This plugin is a user-facing media tool that adds local OCR capability to DeepSeek Harness. Its main purpose is converting pasted or provided images into text (especially screenshots/聊天记录/文档场景) through offline PP-OCRv5 on ONNX Runtime, with support for both Web and TUI input flows. Secondary functionality includes local setup/caching of OCR models and environment bootstrap.

capabilities: Extracts text from local images (OCR) and returns recognized text for agent use
Supports image paste-to-path flow in both DSH Web and TUI environments
Provides local OCR setup/download tooling (environment bootstrap, model download, cache/config options)
Modifies local client behavior via install scripts (e.g., TUI paste-key binding setup)

reasons.code: README documents primary flow: paste image in TUI/Web, agent calls ocr_image to read text locally via PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime.
Repository ships setup assets (ocr/setup.py, install scripts) for local environment/model initialization, indicating dependency/runtime installation and local model caching behavior.
Plugin is packaged for DSH via manifest/exports and includes patch files and profile config hooks, confirming integration into user client behavior.
